SELECT 
    s.reckey as shipment_id,
    s.shiptok as ship_to,
    s.log_ts as log_timestamp,
    sop->'route'->'origin'->>'nation' as origin_nation,
    sop->'route'->'destination'->>'nation' as dest_nation,
    (sop->'timing_performance'->>'distance_km')::numeric as distance_km,
    (sop->'timing_performance'->>'planned_eta_hrs')::numeric as planned_eta_hrs,
    (sop->'timing_performance'->>'actual_duration_hrs')::numeric as actual_duration_hrs,
    ir.risk_level,
    ir.incident_risk_record,
    ic.claimneed,
    ic.claimstat,
    ic.claimusd,
    gc.gdp_compliance,
    pc.pack_condition,
    qr.quarantine_reason,
    em_temp.avg_c as avg_temp_c,
    em_temp.max_c as max_temp_c,
    em_temp.min_c as min_temp_c,
    em_temp.alarm_count,
    em_temp.excursion_count,
    em_hum.humidity_monitor,
    em_hum.humidity_excursion_count,
    em_shock.shock_event_count
FROM shipments s
LEFT JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(s.shipment_overview) AS sop ON true
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT 
        jsonb_extract_path_text(ir.incr, 'risk', 'risk_level') as risk_level
    FROM incidentandriskmanagement ir 
    WHERE ir.reckeyrisk = s.reckey
) ir ON true
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT claimneed, claimstat, claimusd, costimpactusd
    FROM insuranceclaims ic 
    WHERE ic.reckeyclaim = s.reckey
) ic ON true
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT 
        jsonb_extract_path_text(qc.qcc, 'gdp_quality', 'gdp_compliance') as gdp_compliance,
        jsonb_extract_path_text(qc.qcc, 'product_integrity', 'pack_condition') as pack_condition,
        jsonb_extract_path_text(qc.qcc, 'release', 'quarantine_reason') as quarantine_reason
    FROM qualitycompliance qc 
    WHERE qc.reckeyqc = s.reckey
) gc ON true
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT 
        jsonb_extract_path_text(em.em, 'temperature', 'avg_c')::numeric as avg_c,
        jsonb_extract_path_text(em.em, 'temperature', 'max_c')::numeric as max_c,
        jsonb_extract_path_text(em.em, 'temperature', 'min_c')::numeric as min_c,
        jsonb_extract_path_text(em.em, 'temperature', 'alarm_count')::int as alarm_count,
        jsonb_extract_path_text(em.em, 'temperature', 'excursion_count')::int as excursion_count,
        jsonb_extract_path_text(em.em, 'humidity', 'humidity_monitor') as humidity_monitor,
        jsonb_extract_path_text(em.em, 'humidity', 'excursion_count')::int as humidity_excursion_count,
        jsonb_extract_path_text(em.em, 'light_and_shock', 'shock_event_count')::int as shock_event_count
    FROM environmentalmonitoring em 
    WHERE em.reckeylink = s.reckey
) em_temp ON true
WHERE ir.risk_level = 'High' 
   OR ic.claimneed IN ('Yes', 'Under Review')
   OR gc.gdp_compliance = 'Non-compliant'
   OR gc.pack_condition IN ('Damaged', 'Compromised')
   OR gc.quarantine_reason IS NOT NULL
   OR em_temp.excursion_count > 0
ORDER BY 
    CASE WHEN ir.risk_level = 'High' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END,
    COALESCE(ic.claimusd, 0) DESC
LIMIT 50;

        WHERE ir.reckeyrisk = s.reckey
    ) ir ON true
    WHERE ir.risk_level = 'High' AND ir.market_impact = 'Significant'
) t;

-- High risk AND reputation_impact = Major
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (
    SELECT s.reckey
    FROM shipments s
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT 
            jsonb_extract_path_text(incident_risk_record, 'risk', 'risk_level') as risk_level,
            jsonb_extract_path_text(incident_risk_record, 'impact', 'reputation_impact') as reputation_impact
        FROM incidentandriskmanagement ir 
        WHERE ir.reckeyrisk = s.reckey
    ) ir ON true
    WHERE ir.risk_level = 'High' AND ir.reputation_impact = 'Major'
) t;

-- High risk AND (market_impact = Significant OR reputation_impact = Major)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (
    SELECT s.reckey
    FROM shipments s
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT 
            jsonb_extract_path_text(incident_risk_record, 'risk', 'risk_level') as risk_level,
            jsonb_extract_path_text(incident_risk_record, 'impact', 'market_impact') as market_impact,
            jsonb_extract_path_text(incident_risk_record, 'impact', 'reputation_impact') as reputation_impact
        FROM incidentandriskmanagement ir 
        WHERE ir.reckeyrisk = s.reckey
    ) ir ON true
    WHERE ir.risk_level = 'High' AND (ir.market_impact = 'Significant' OR ir.reputation_impact = 'Major')
) t;

-- Non-compliant GDP AND damaged/compromised pack AND quarantine
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (
    SELECT s.reckey
    FROM shipments s
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT 
            jsonb_extract_path_text(qc_checklist, 'gdp_quality', 'gdp_compliance') as gdp_compliance,
            jsonb_extract_path_text(qc_checklist, 'product_integrity', 'pack_condition') as pack_condition,
            jsonb_extract_path_text(qc_checklist, 'release', 'quarantine_reason') as quarantine_reason
        FROM qualitycompliance qc 
        WHERE qc.reckeyqc = s.reckey
    ) gc ON true
    WHERE gc.gdp_compliance = 'Non-compliant' AND gc.pack_condition IN ('Damaged', 'Compromised') AND gc.quarantine_reason IS NOT NULL
) t;

-- Let me try: High risk AND claims AND (non-compliant OR damaged)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (
    SELECT s.reckey
    FROM shipments s
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT jsonb_extract_path_text(incident_risk_record, 'risk', 'risk_level') as risk_level
        FROM incidentandriskmanagement ir 
        WHERE ir.reckeyrisk = s.reckey
    ) ir ON true
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT claimneed
        FROM insuranceclaims ic 
        WHERE ic.reckeyclaim = s.reckey
    ) ic ON true
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT 
            jsonb_extract_path_text(qc_checklist, 'gdp_quality', 'gdp_compliance') as gdp_compliance,
            jsonb_extract_path_text(qc_checklist, 'product_integrity', 'pack_condition') as pack_condition
        FROM qualitycompliance qc 
        WHERE qc.reckeyqc = s.reckey
    ) gc ON true
    WHERE ir.risk_level = 'High' AND ic.claimneed IN ('Yes', 'Under Review') AND (gc.gdp_compliance = 'Non-compliant' OR gc.pack_condition IN ('Damaged', 'Compromised'))
) t;

-- Just high risk shipments - how many?
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.reckey) FROM shipments s 
JOIN incidentandriskmanagement ir ON ir.reckeyrisk = s.reckey
WHERE jsonb_extract_path_text(incident_risk_record, 'risk', 'risk_level') = 'High';

-- Let me check: claims with claimneed = 'Yes' (not Under Review)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.reckey) FROM shipments s 
JOIN insuranceclaims ic ON ic.reckeyclaim = s.reckey
WHERE ic.claimneed = 'Yes';

-- Let me try: shipments with non-compliant GDP AND claims
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.reckey) FROM shipments s 
JOIN qualitycompliance qc ON qc.reckeyqc = s.reckey
JOIN insuranceclaims ic ON ic.reckeyclaim = s.reckey
WHERE jsonb_extract_path_text(qc_checklist, 'gdp_quality', 'gdp_compliance') = 'Non-compliant'
AND ic.claimneed IN ('Yes', 'Under Review');

-- Let me try: High risk AND claims AND quarantine reason
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.reckey) FROM shipments s 
JOIN incidentandriskmanagement ir ON ir.reckeyrisk = s.reckey
JOIN insuranceclaims ic ON ic.reckeyclaim = s.reckey
JOIN qualitycompliance qc ON qc.reckeyqc = s.reckey
WHERE jsonb_extract_path_text(incident_risk_record, 'risk', 'risk_level') = 'High'
AND ic.claimneed IN ('Yes', 'Under Review')
AND jsonb_extract_path_text(qc_checklist, 'release', 'quarantine_reason') IS NOT NULL;

-- Let me try: High risk AND (damaged OR quarantine)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.reckey) FROM shipments s 
JOIN incidentandriskmanagement ir ON ir.reckeyrisk = s.reckey
JOIN qualitycompliance qc ON qc.reckeyqc = s.reckey
WHERE jsonb_extract_path_text(incident_risk_record, 'risk', 'risk_level') = 'High'
AND (jsonb_extract_path_text(qc_checklist, 'product_integrity', 'pack_condition') IN ('Damaged', 'Compromised') 
     OR jsonb_extract_path_text(qc_checklist, 'release', 'quarantine_reason') IS NOT NULL);

-- Temperature excursion count >= 5
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.reckey) FROM shipments s 
JOIN environmentalmonitoring em ON em.reckeylink = s.reckey
WHERE jsonb_extract_path_text(env_metrics, 'temperature', 'excursion_count')::int >= 5;
